message:
Dear {{ doc.first_name }},

Welcome to our church family! We are thrilled to have you as a member of our congregation and look forward to walking with you in faith.

Our pastor or one of our deacons will reach out to you shortly. In the meantime, please don't hesitate to contact us with any questions or needs.

Sign in to our Member Portal to sign up for events, share prayer requests, and stay connected with your church family. If you have no login yet, ask the church office to invite you.

"So then you are no longer strangers and aliens, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and members of the household of God." (Ephesians 2:19)

In Christ,
{{ church_name(doc) or "The Pastoral Team" }}
name: New Member Welcome
subject: Welcome to Our Church Family!
